policy: Entries must use a vendor-authoritative HTTPS source and a vendor-published SHA-256 value. Do not stage a product until its version, source URL, checksum, support channel, and approval status are verified.

packages.stagingBlocker: Record an approved four-part Chrome vendor version, a unique three-part Gallery version, an immutable authorized package source, SHA-256, signer evidence, exact package file name, reviewed install/remove commands, and change approval before publishing.
